verdict.rationale: GST runs its own Developer Portal (developer.gst.gov.in/apiportal) with Register and Login entry points. That signals a first-party API program and a plausible key-issuance path. The evidence shows only the portal's home-page navigation, with no endpoints or limits on display. Missing for 10: published endpoint documentation, an explicit key or credential issuance process, stated rate limits, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of API access.
